question: What minimal algebraic structure within unitary evolution first enables persistent self-referential records without external baths or hidden degrees of freedom?

responses_summary.grok: The minimal structure is the fixed-point subalgebra \(\mathcal{A}^U=\{A\mid U(t)AU^\dagger(t)=A\ \forall t\}\) (equivalently, the commutant of the Hamiltonian inside the ambient operator algebra).

sibling_exchange.content: A finite-dimensional C*-algebra admitting a faithful trace and a one-parameter unitary group whose fixed-point subalgebra contains nontrivial projections; these projections serve as the first persistent self-referential records under pure unitary flow.
